About

The climate crisis demands collective preparedness, evidence-based research, creative innovation, and a good podcast for hunkering down in your bunker.

Surviving the Climate is hosted by longtime friends Robbie Parks, a professor, and Nate Matthews-Trigg, an emergency manager. They cover climate and disaster news, pop culture, and the latest research, with practical insights for regular people making do with what they have.

Episodes (hopefully) won’t be too serious, feature expert guests, and draw on r/heat_prep and other forums they moderate.

Produced by Marcelo Jauregui-Volpe.
